rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who looks or feels forlorn, lonely, and miserable.

example.english: They sat alone at the street corner, looking forlorn.
example.traditional: 佢一個人坐喺街角，個樣好淒涼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 co5 hai2 gaai1 gok3 go3 joeng2 hou2 cai1 loeng4

rows.note: Use this for a forlorn place, building, or piece of land that has been abandoned and left unused.

example.english: That cinema has stood forlorn and dark for years.
example.traditional: 嗰間荒廢咗好多年嘅戲院，成日都黑漆漆。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 fong1 fai3 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 ge3 hei3 jyun2 seng4 jat6 dou1 hak1 cat1 cat1

rows.note: Use this when a plan, attempt, or situation is unlikely to succeed.

example.english: If we keep dragging this out, this plan is truly forlorn and will not succeed.
example.traditional: 再咁樣拖落去，呢個計劃真係冇希望成功。
example.jyutping: zoi3 gam3 joeng2 to1 lok6 heoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zan1 hai6 mou5 hei1 mong6 sing4 gung1
